title: Cayenne E-Hybrid
infotainment: Porsche Driver Experience: 12.6" curved cluster + 12.3" center + optional 10.9" passenger. PCM 6.0. Wireless CarPlay/Android Auto. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/cayenne/
adasStandard: Porsche Active Safe (FCW+AEB), Lane Keep Assist, blind-spot monitor, rear cross-traffic alert, driver-attention camera. ACC optional. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/cayenne/cayenne-e-hybrid-models/cayenne-e-hybrid/
adasOptional: Adaptive Cruise + Lane Change Assist + Active Lane Keep (Premium / Premium Plus package), Surround View, Night Vision Assist, InnoDrive. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/cayenne/

subscriptionFeatures: Porsche Connect Plus included 3 yr (~$199/yr renewal). PHEV does NOT get the Electrify America DC-fast charging promo (PHEV uses AC L2 only — no DC port).
drmNotes: Drives offline. Porsche Connect 3 yr included; renewal ~$199/yr. Cayenne PHEV connectivity supports Plug & Charge with select networks. Function-on-Demand store offers post-purchase paid software unlocks for some features (lane keep enhancements, performance modes on some markets). Source: https://connect-store2.porsche.com/us/en/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch. Driver-attention camera alerts only.
knownIssues: Long-term Cayenne PHEV issues across generations: cooling-pump failures (well-documented service item), hybrid battery management module faults requiring dealer reflash, occasional 12V battery drain. New 25.9 kWh battery and updated charger likely improve reliability but data is too early. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/porsche/cayenne/
recalls: MY2024-25 Cayenne PHEV: software-related recalls for hybrid control unit (carryover). Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Cayenne PHEV is foreign-assembled (Slovakia), so does NOT qualify for federal IRA EV tax credit. Some state PHEV programs may include it but most have MSRP caps that exclude. Source: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/taxphevb.shtml

title: Macan
infotainment: Porsche Driver Experience: 12.6" curved driver display + 10.9" center + optional 10.9" passenger display + optional AR HUD. PCM 6.0. Wireless CarPlay/Android Auto.
adasStandard: Porsche Active Safe (FCW+AEB), Lane Keep Assist, blind-spot monitor, rear cross-traffic alert, driver-attention camera, ParkAssist with rear sensors. ACC optional. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/macan/macan-electric-models/macan/
adasOptional: Adaptive Cruise + Active Lane Keep (Assistance Plus package ~$3,500), Lane Change Assist, Surround View, Park Assist Plus with semi-autonomous parking, augmented-reality HUD, Night Vision Assist. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/macan/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard backup camera with dynamic guidelines. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/macan/
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround View 360 with virtual top-down view optional (part of Park Assist Plus). Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/macan/
subscriptionFeatures: Porsche Connect Plus 3 yr included then ~$199/yr (live nav, app remote). Function on Demand: ~$300-1000+ paid unlocks for software features (varies). 3 yr complimentary Electrify America 30-min DC sessions. Source: https://www.electrifyamerica.com/porsche/
drmNotes: Drives offline. Porsche Connect 3 years included; renewal ~$199/yr. Macan Electric is a flagship example of Porsche's FoD (function-on-demand) approach — multiple features (Active Lane Keep upgrades, intelligent range management, expanded smartphone app functions, extended drive modes) listed on Porsche Connect Store as post-purchase paid software unlocks even when hardware is pre-installed. Source: https://connect-store2.porsche.com/us/en/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch. Driver-attention camera (gaze tracking) is standard but only generates drowsiness/distraction alerts.
knownIssues: Early MY25 launch: infotainment software bugs (some addressed via OTA), occasional charge-port latch hesitation, software-driven start delays reported on forums. Major NHTSA recall 24V-XXX (early production) for software causing battery monitoring fault. Source: https://www.macanevforum.com/
recalls: NHTSA 24V-770 (battery monitoring software, all 2025 Porsche BEVs including Macan Electric). NHTSA 24V-XXX rearview camera display software (carryover from initial launch software). Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Not eligible for federal credit (foreign-assembled, MSRP exceeds $80k SUV cap on higher trims but base is under — however foreign assembly disqualifies). Commercial lease pass-through possible. Most state programs exclude due to MSRP. Source: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/taxevb.shtml

title: Taycan
infotainment: Porsche Communication Management (PCM 6.0) with 16.8" curved driver display + 10.9" central touchscreen + optional 10.9" passenger display. Wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless Android Auto (added 2024). Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/taycan/taycan-models/
adasStandard: Porsche Active Safe (forward collision warning + AEB), Lane Keep Assist with traffic sign recognition, blind-spot monitor, rear cross-traffic alert, driver-attention camera (new 2025). Adaptive Cruise Control is optional ($1,800), not standard. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/taycan/taycan-models/taycan/ (build configurator)
adasOptional: Adaptive Cruise Control with Traffic Jam Assist ($1,800), Lane Change Assist, Park Assist with surround view, Night Vision Assist (rare option), InnoDrive (predictive cruise that reads navigation data). Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/taycan/taycan-models/taycan/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard backup camera with dynamic guidelines. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/taycan/taycan-models/taycan/
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround View (360-degree camera system) optional. Source: https://www.porsche.com/usa/models/taycan/taycan-models/taycan/
subscriptionFeatures: Porsche Connect Plus (live nav, online radio, app remote): included 3 years, then ~$199/year. Function-on-Demand store offers post-purchase paid unlocks for features whose hardware is pre-installed (e.g., InnoDrive subscription, Power Steering Plus on some markets). Charging Service: no monthly fee, pay-per-session billed via Porsche ID; 3 years complimentary Electrify America 30-min sessions (one per stop). Source: https://connect-store2.porsche.com/us/en/
drmNotes: Vehicle drives offline. Porsche Connect (3 years included) requires connectivity for: live navigation traffic, charging-network search/routing, remote app (lock/unlock, charge control, climate pre-cond), Spotify/Apple Music streaming, voice assistant cloud functions. Wireless CarPlay/Android Auto work via phone connection. Some features (e.g., Lane Keep Assist, Power Steering Plus on some configs) gated behind paid post-purchase software unlocks via Porsche's 'function on demand' store. Source: https://connect-store2.porsche.com/us/en/
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving kill switch present in MY2025. Driver-attention camera (new standard for 2025) issues visual/audible drowsiness alerts only — no vehicle disable or speed limit actuation. Source: https://newsroom.porsche.com/en_US/products/taycan/taycan-2024-update-35498.html
knownIssues: Early-2025 deliveries: occasional 12V battery drain (carryover from earlier Taycans, multiple TSBs). Charging-port latch failures (carryover, multiple recalls on prior MYs). Infotainment lockups requiring drive-cycle reboot reported on owner forums. Source: https://www.truedelta.com/Porsche-Taycan/reliability
recalls: MY2025 recalls (as of May 2026): NHTSA 24V-770 (battery thermal monitoring software, all 2025 Taycan BEV) — software update at dealer. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: No federal credit (foreign assembly, MSRP exceeds $55k sedan cap regardless). Some state EV rebates apply but income/price caps typically exclude Taycan (CA CVRP retired 2023; CA Clean Vehicle Rebate has $45k cap). MA MOR-EV and NY Drive Clean exclude vehicles above ~$50-55k MSRP. Lease-loophole pass-through historically applied (commercial clean vehicle credit), check current dealer offers. Source: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/tax2023.shtml
